sprints.name: Ground
sprints.goal: Everyone can build against one pinned workspace; Vultr access, VMs and model ids confirmed.
sprints.gate: G0 22:00: scaffold compiles, Vultr key works, VMs provisioning. Else rooms develop on local Linux Docker and deploy moves to Sun 08:00.

sprints.name: Vertical slice
sprints.goal: Paste a URL → sealed crawl → report → sign in → claim → the Move to a candidate with parity → the site serves a signed release with Ask.
sprints.gate: G1 04:00: if replay is not working, R4.4 fallback (crawl + WXR) is the path.

sprints.name: Owner decides
sprints.goal: Go-live with a passkey, undo, Trust tab, replay, the agent door, first deploy on Vultr, egress review passed.
sprints.gate: G2 08:00: egress review passes or deploy is blocked. G3 10:00: agent race or its fallback.

sprints.name: Gauntlet and polish
sprints.goal: 10/10 gauntlet from receipts on the live URL; acceptance run; README, slides, video.

sprints.name: Ship
sprints.goal: Defects burned down; freeze 17:00; submitted by 20:00 (hard close Mon 02:00).

tasks.title: Approve requirements and design (or mark changes)
tasks.done_when: James says go, or lists changes on the board

tasks.title: Put VULTR_INFERENCE_API_KEY and a Vultr API key (for provisioning) in a local .env; confirm credits
tasks.done_when: Keys present in the .env files named by S0-04 and S0-05; nobody else types them

tasks.title: Choose the platform domain and the fixture domain; delegate both to Vultr DNS
tasks.done_when: Domains named on the board; NS records point to Vultr

tasks.title: cloud-init and provisioning script for control, sandbox (VX1) and fixture VMs, VPC and firewall groups; James approves creation
tasks.done_when: Three VMs reachable over the VPC; firewall groups as in design §2; script in deploy/

tasks.title: Confirm Vultr model ids via GET /v1/models; fix the routing table and the embedding model
tasks.done_when: Routing table in design §4.3 updated with confirmed ids and tool/vision support

tasks.title: Workspace scaffold: every Brick 1 crate as a compiling skeleton, adk-rust pinned rev, shared deps, CI (fmt, clippy, test); later tasks never edit root files
tasks.done_when: cargo check --workspace passes; CI green; crates per design §3 exist

tasks.title: Passkey spike: adk-surface WebAuthn verification vs webauthn-rs; record decision D9
tasks.done_when: Decision written in design D9 with the reason

tasks.title: agentrix-types: JobSpec, JobResult, Receipt, Finding, DecisionCard, EffectRequest; Ed25519 + RFC 8785 signing
tasks.done_when: Types and sign/verify round-trip tests pass

tasks.title: SQLite schema and migrations (design §5) and the CAS store
tasks.done_when: Migrations run on a fresh DB; CAS put/get by digest tested

tasks.title: Free disk on James's Mac to >= 25 GB (stale target dirs), with James's OK per deletion
tasks.done_when: df shows >= 25 GB free

tasks.title: Land #1348; rerun #1345, #1347, #1349; tell the coordinator the adk-rust rev to pin
tasks.done_when: Pinned rev builds the scaffold; PR states on the board

tasks.title: Spec committed; Brick 1 board live; lanes briefed
tasks.done_when: Board shows every task; each lane has its brief

tasks.title: agentrix-runner: verify signed specs; Docker + runsc rooms; caps; read-only root; non-root; artifacts by digest; destroy and confirm; JobEvent stream
tasks.done_when: A fetch job runs in gVisor on the sandbox VM and returns a result with destroyed=true

tasks.title: Room images: room-fetch, room-render, room-build (pinned digests)
tasks.done_when: Each image runs one job to completion under its caps

tasks.title: Egress wiring: per-job allowlist from the spec into agentrix-egress; sandbox nftables force room traffic through it
tasks.done_when: A room cannot reach any host off its allowlist, nor 169.254.169.254

tasks.title: agentrix-models: purpose routing, metering, budgets, backoff, /v1/screen and /v1/decide
tasks.done_when: Each purpose answers from Vultr; usage rows written; 429 path tested

tasks.title: Broker client in agentrix-node and the Assess pipeline: crawl job → adk-site scan findings → plain-words report
tasks.done_when: Assessing the fixture domain lists its planted spam links and footer script with evidence

tasks.title: agentrix-move: inventory (crawl + WXR) → sanitise, detect, quarantine → rebuild → render → parity; persisted, resumable steps
tasks.done_when: The fixture reaches a candidate release with parity >= 0.95 and the infection quarantined

tasks.title: Sign-in server: passkey register/login; password + TOTP fallback; sessions; claim by DNS TXT or file, verified from the sandbox
tasks.done_when: Register, sign out, sign in by passkey and by TOTP; claim verified on the fixture domain

tasks.title: Port templates: start/assess, sign-in, claim, the Move (SSE), console shell
tasks.done_when: Screens render real data on a phone width, light and dark

tasks.title: Converted site theme; edge serves verified releases by Host; Ask this site (SSE, citations, AI disclosure, honest don't-know)
tasks.done_when: A cited answer and an honest don't-know on the rebuilt fixture site

tasks.title: Sealed browser for room-fetch (B1) and the frame feed (B2, #1349); fallback screenshotter
tasks.done_when: Frames stream to the Assess screen from a sealed room

tasks.title: Fixture: infected WordPress compose from examples/website S3 + the infected overlay + the ten attacks; on the fixture VM
tasks.done_when: The fixture site is live on the fixture domain with all ten attacks planted

tasks.title: Deploy pipeline: build on the control VM, ship runner and egress to sandbox, systemd units, Caddy TLS, smoke test
tasks.done_when: deploy/deploy.sh takes a commit to a running stack with a passing smoke test

tasks.title: LaunchGate: card fingerprint (release digest + charter v1); sign the release on approval; atomic pointer switch; probes; rollback for 30 days
tasks.done_when: Approve → live < 60 s; rollback restores the previous release

tasks.title: Go-live card and Decisions: passkey approval over the fingerprint; starting levels in plain words; locked positions
tasks.done_when: The owner approves go-live with a passkey on a phone

tasks.title: Trust tab (receipts: list, open, verify; gauntlet score) and the Today view
tasks.done_when: Every receipt opens and verifies against the published key

tasks.title: Chief WebAgent brief for Today, from activity and receipts (concierge purpose)
tasks.done_when: A plain-words brief of what happened, with links to receipts

tasks.title: room-replay: WordPress from WXR/dump, internal-only network; microVM on VX1 if available, else gVisor
tasks.done_when: Replay inventory produced; the phone-home attempt fails and is on the receipt

tasks.title: Quarantine review; restore as a signed decision with a reason
tasks.done_when: Owner restores a false positive; decision on the receipt

tasks.title: Agent door: AWP discovery + MCP request_custom_order → held → owner card → pollable status
tasks.done_when: An agent's order raises the owner's card and polls its status

tasks.title: Concierge refusal policy (no discounts, no instructions); the attempt shows in the console; AWP/Markdown twins
tasks.done_when: Gauntlet attack 10 refused and surfaced

tasks.title: Independent egress security review: one test per case (rebinding, redirects, IPv6/encoded, CONNECT, smuggling); architecture fixes what fails; sign-off
tasks.done_when: All cases pass in crates/agentrix-egress/tests; sign-off noted on the board

tasks.title: First deploy on Vultr: three VMs, HTTPS live URL
tasks.done_when: Live URL serves the start page over HTTPS

tasks.title: Usage meter and budget in the console; model cost per Move
tasks.done_when: Cost per Move shown; budget stop tested

tasks.title: Gauntlet runner: ten attacks against a deployment; score from receipts; on the Trust tab; runs on every deploy
tasks.done_when: 10/10 on the live URL, computed from receipts

tasks.title: Acceptance run: verify every Must criterion on the live URL; file defects on the board
tasks.done_when: Each Must criterion marked verified or failed with a defect

tasks.title: Agent race rehearsal with computer use; keep or fall back by 10:00
tasks.done_when: Decision on the board

tasks.title: Releases and evidence on Vultr Object Storage
tasks.done_when: A release served from Object Storage-backed CAS

tasks.title: Accessibility and performance pass on site and console
tasks.done_when: AA checks pass on demo paths; LCP < 2.5 s; Ask first token < 2 s

tasks.title: Concierge retrieval on Vultr's vector store
tasks.done_when: Ask answers cite chunks retrieved from Vultr

tasks.title: README: How we use Vultr, architecture, how the agent does real work, disclosure of what pre-existed
tasks.done_when: README reviewed by James

tasks.title: Slides (PDF) and the video script under 5 minutes: problem, market, revenue, competition, future
tasks.done_when: Slides and script approved by James

tasks.title: Switch gate: when acceptance passes on Claude (Phase 1), run the bake-off, switch routes to Vultr by configuration, re-run acceptance and the gauntlet on Vultr
tasks.done_when: Routes on Vultr; acceptance and 10/10 gauntlet pass on Vultr; bake-off result and route change on receipts

tasks.title: Record the video (live gauntlet, live go-live, the race or its fallback) on Vultr routes
tasks.done_when: Video uploaded

tasks.title: Feature freeze 17:00; final deploy; gauntlet re-run 10/10
